content:
设  
\[
U=\frac{\sum_{i=1}^6 X_i^2}{\sigma^2},\qquad 
V=\frac{\sum_{j=1}^6 X_{j+6}^2}{\sigma^2}
\]
由于 \(X_i\sim N(0,\sigma^2)\) 且相互独立，所以

\[
U\sim \chi^2(6),\qquad V\sim \chi^2(6)
\]

且 \(U,V\) 独立。于是

\[
Y=\frac{\sum_{i=1}^6 X_i^2}{\sum_{j=1}^6 X_{j+6}^2}
=\frac{U}{V}
=\frac{U/6}{V/6}
\]

因此

\[
Y\sim F(6,6)
\]

答案：D
